title:
A heavy tramcar honking its gong slewed between.
 
 Lost it. Curse your noisy pugnose. Feels locked out of it.
html_source: Poor Bloom had been positioning himself to ogle the rich woman as she climbed into the lorry, but a tramcar passed at precisely the wrong (for Bloom) moment, obscuring his view. He mentally curses what, the tramcar? the tramcar driver? M'Coy? as a pugnose.
